about: Invented messages for Alex Chen at an invented company. Each case says whether the message holds an ask for Alex. They exist so the eval harness works before any real correction does; real cases from Not a task and missed tasks join them.

cases.name: dm-direct-ask
cases.why: A DM that names a deliverable and a day

input.text: Hey! Can you send me the Q3 vendor numbers by Thursday? Finance wants them before the planning review.

expected.ask: Send Priya the Q3 vendor numbers

cases.name: facilities-fyi
cases.why: An announcement to everyone with nothing to do

input.title: Office closed Monday
input.text:
Hi all,

The office will be closed Monday for HVAC maintenance. Remote work as usual; badges won't work that day.

Thanks,
Facilities

cases.name: ask-for-someone-else
cases.why: Alex is on the thread, but the ask names Dana

input.title: Northwind renewal
input.text:
Thanks both. Northwind signed off on the terms. Dana, can you send them the final contract today so legal can countersign?

Marcus

cases.name: can-someone-big-channel
cases.why: "Can someone" to a 200-person channel: unclear, not Alex's

input.text: Can someone take a look at the flaky checkout test? It's failed three of the last five runs on main.

cases.name: meeting-action-item
cases.why: A meeting action item assigned to Alex by name

input.text:
Action items:
| Owner | Item |
| Sam | Confirm the press date with comms |
| Alex | Draft the launch FAQ for support |
| Priya | Book the demo room |

expected.ask: Draft the launch FAQ for support

cases.name: thank-you
cases.why: A thank-you closes nothing new and asks for nothing

cases.name: buried-ask
cases.why: A long status update with one ask for Alex at the end

input.title: Offsite update
input.text:
Quick update on the offsite:

- Venue is held through Friday
- Catering quotes are in; going with the second one
- Travel is booked for everyone but Marcus, who's driving

Alex, could you confirm the final headcount with me before Friday so I can release the deposit?

Sam

expected.ask: Confirm the offsite headcount with Sam

cases.name: own-invite-note
cases.why: Alex's own invite: the calendar already holds it

input.title: Invitation: Roadmap walkthrough
input.text: Setting up time to walk through the Q1 roadmap before it goes to leadership.

cases.name: own-commitment
cases.why: Alex's own message commits to something beyond itself

input.text: Good call. I'll send the revised pricing deck to the group by Friday.

expected.ask: Send the revised pricing deck by Friday
